purpose: Four photographic material tiles blended on live 3D Free Flight terrain.

Top-left quadrant: richly detailed natural green meadow grass, irregular subtle dry olive grass and brown soil mottling, tiny stones, not neon. Top-right quadrant: aerial view straight down on dense mixed woodland canopy, many irregular overlapping deep green tree crowns of varying shapes, natural organic texture and depth, not a geometric grid. Bottom-left quadrant: rugged gray-brown granite and weathered exposed rock, fine fractures, ridges, mineral mottling and sparse moss, neutral medium gray. Bottom-right quadrant: pale warm beige coastal sand with delicate irregular wind ripples, tiny pebbles, subtly damp patches, no water. Each quadrant must be usable as a seamless repeating texture on its own, with consistent colors and density at its opposite edges. Highly detailed realistic photographic material scans, restrained colors, no artistic brush strokes. Square 2048x2048 texture-atlas composition.
